  <style id="editor-styles">
    body{padding-bottom:8rem}.editor-bar{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:20;background:#101625;border-top:1px solid #64ffc1;padding:.8rem max(1.25rem,calc((100vw - 1160px)/2));display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;flex-wrap:wrap;box-shadow:0 -8px 30px #0004}.editor-bar button{font:700 .9rem Consolas,monospace;background:#64ffc1;color:#0c101b;padding:.65rem .9rem;border:1px solid #64ffc1;cursor:pointer}.editor-bar button+button{background:transparent;color:#e8ecf7;border-color:#65718a}.editor-bar p{font-size:.8rem;color:#bdc7da;margin:0;flex:1;min-width:230px}.editor-bar [hidden]{display:none!important}.editor-bar button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #9d88ff;outline-offset:3px}[data-edit]{white-space:pre-line}body.editing [contenteditable]{outline:1px dashed #64ffc188;outline-offset:5px;cursor:text}body.editing [contenteditable]:focus{outline:2px solid #64ffc1}body.editing .project details{display:block}@media(max-width:760px){body{padding-bottom:11rem}.editor-bar p{flex-basis:100%}}
  </style>
  <script id="portfolio-editor">
    (() => {
      const key = 'eren-ayaz-portfolio-content-v1';
      const fields = [...document.querySelectorAll('.brand > span:last-child,.hero .eyebrow,.hero h1,.hero-bottom p,.work .section-heading h2,.work .section-heading p,.cover-label,.cover-caption,.project-meta span,.project h3,.project > p,.project.wide > div > p,.detail-body p,.about .eyebrow,.about h2,.about-copy > p,.background h3,.background p,.footer p'), ...document.querySelectorAll('.contact-edit')];
      fields.forEach((field, i) => { field.dataset.edit ||= 'field-' + i; });
      const status = document.getElementById('edit-status');
      const toggle = document.getElementById('edit-toggle');
      const saveButton = document.getElementById('save-edit');
      let editing = false;
      const readText = field => {
        if (field.getClientRects().length) return field.innerText;
        const clone = field.cloneNode(true);
        clone.querySelectorAll('br').forEach(br => br.replaceWith('\n'));
        clone.querySelectorAll('div').forEach(div => { div.before('\n'); });
        return clone.textContent;
      };
      const originalText = Object.fromEntries(fields.map(field => [field.dataset.edit, readText(field)]));
      try {
        const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || '{}');
        fields.forEach(field => { if (typeof saved[field.dataset.edit] === 'string' && saved[field.dataset.edit] !== readText(field)) field.textContent = saved[field.dataset.edit]; });
      } catch { status.textContent = 'Browser storage is unavailable. Download your website to keep edits.'; }
      const snapshot = () => Object.fromEntries(fields.filter(field => readText(field) !== originalText[field.dataset.edit]).map(field => [field.dataset.edit, readText(field)]));
      function finish() {
        try { localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(snapshot())); }
        catch { status.textContent = 'Could not save in this browser. Download your website to keep edits.'; return false; }
        setEditing(false);
        status.textContent = 'Saved in this browser. Download your website to use it elsewhere.';
        return true;
      }
      function setEditing(value) {
        editing = value;
        document.body.classList.toggle('editing', value);
        fields.forEach(field => {
          if (value) { field.setAttribute('contenteditable', 'plaintext-only'); field.setAttribute('spellcheck', 'true'); }
          else { field.removeAttribute('contenteditable'); field.removeAttribute('spellcheck'); }
        });
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(value));
        toggle.textContent = value ? 'Editing enabled' : 'Edit portfolio';
        toggle.disabled = value;
        saveButton.hidden = !value;
        if (value) { document.querySelectorAll('.project details').forEach(detail => { detail.open = true; }); status.textContent = 'Click any outlined text to change it. Select Save & finish when ready.'; }
      }
      toggle.addEventListener('click', () => setEditing(true));
      saveButton.addEventListener('click', finish);
      document.addEventListener('click', event => { if (editing && event.target.closest('[data-edit]') && event.target.closest('a')) event.preventDefault(); });
      fields.forEach(field => {
        field.addEventListener('input', () => { status.textContent = 'Unsaved changes. Select Save & finish, or download a copy.'; });
        field.addEventListener('paste', event => { event.preventDefault(); const text = event.clipboardData.getData('text/plain'); const selection = window.getSelection(); if (!selection.rangeCount) return; const range = selection.getRangeAt(0); range.deleteContents(); const node = document.createTextNode(text); range.insertNode(node); range.setStartAfter(node); range.collapse(true); selection.removeAllRanges(); selection.addRange(range); field.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); });
      });
      document.getElementById('download-page').addEventListener('click', async () => {
        try {
          const clone = document.documentElement.cloneNode(true);
          let stylesheet = document.getElementById('portfolio-theme');
          if (!stylesheet) {
            const response = await fetch(new URL('style.css', document.baseURI));
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Stylesheet unavailable');
            stylesheet = document.createElement('style'); stylesheet.id = 'portfolio-theme'; stylesheet.textContent = await response.text();
          }
          clone.querySelector('link[rel="stylesheet"]')?.replaceWith(stylesheet.cloneNode(true));
          clone.querySelector('body').classList.remove('editing','rotating','transitioning');
          clone.querySelectorAll('.rotation-layer').forEach(layer => layer.remove());
          clone.querySelector('body').classList.remove('warp-active');
          clone.querySelectorAll('[contenteditable]').forEach(field => { field.removeAttribute('contenteditable'); field.removeAttribute('spellcheck'); });
          clone.querySelector('#edit-toggle').disabled = false;
          clone.querySelector('#edit-toggle').textContent = 'Edit portfolio';
          clone.querySelector('#edit-toggle').setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
          clone.querySelector('#save-edit').hidden = true;
          clone.querySelector('#edit-status').textContent = 'Edits are saved in this browser. Download to keep a shareable copy.';
          const blob = new Blob(['<!doctype html>\n' + clone.outerHTML], { type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8' });
          const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); const link = document.createElement('a'); link.href = url; link.download = 'eren-ayaz-portfolio.html'; document.body.append(link); link.click(); link.remove(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 10000);
          status.textContent = 'Website downloaded. Your copy includes the current text and design.';
        } catch { status.textContent = 'Could not download the website. Keep this page open and try again.'; }
      });
      window.addEventListener('beforeunload', event => { if (editing) { event.preventDefault(); event.returnValue = ''; } });
    })();
  </script>
  <style id="view-styles">
    [data-view][hidden],#email-link[hidden],#contact-hint[hidden]{display:none!important}html{scroll-behavior:auto}.header{position:relative;z-index:2}.header nav a{padding:.5rem .7rem;border-bottom:2px solid transparent}.header nav a[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--lime);border-color:var(--lime)}.contact{padding-block:5rem;min-height:65vh}.contact h2{font-size:clamp(2.8rem,6vw,5rem);color:var(--lime);line-height:1.1}.contact-intro{max-width:580px;font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--muted);margin-block:2rem}.contact-card{padding:1.7rem;border:1px solid var(--line);max-width:650px;background:#121a2a}.contact-card #contact-email{font-size:clamp(1.1rem,3vw,1.7rem);overflow-wrap:anywhere}.contact-card #contact-hint{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:0}#circle-transition{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:#64ffc1;pointer-events:none;visibility:hidden;clip-path:circle(0% at 50% 50%)}#main{min-height:65vh}#main:focus{outline:none}.work{padding-top:4rem}.footer{margin-top:1.5rem}@media(max-width:760px){.header{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1.2rem}.header nav{width:100%;justify-content:space-between;gap:0}.header nav a{font-size:.85rem;padding:.5rem}.contact{padding-block:3rem}.contact-card{padding:1.2rem}}
  </style>
  <script id="portfolio-navigation">
    (() => {
      const main = document.getElementById('main');
      main.removeAttribute('data-current-view');
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(section => { section.hidden = false; });
      document.body.classList.remove('rotating','transitioning','warp-active');
      if (!document.querySelector('.intro-layout')) {
        const hero = document.getElementById('home');
        const profile = document.querySelector('.about');
        profile.id = 'profile';
        const introduction = document.createElement('div');
        introduction.className = 'intro-layout'; introduction.id = 'about';
        main.prepend(introduction); introduction.append(hero,profile);
      }
      const links = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-route]')];
      const sections = ['about','projects','contact'].map(id => document.getElementById(id));
      let scheduled = false;
      function updateNavigation() {
        scheduled = false;
        let active = sections[0].id;
        for (const section of sections) if (section.getBoundingClientRect().top <= innerHeight*.35) active = section.id;
        links.forEach(link => { if(link.dataset.route === active) link.setAttribute('aria-current','location'); else link.removeAttribute('aria-current'); });
      }
      window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{ if(!scheduled) { scheduled=true; requestAnimationFrame(updateNavigation); } },{passive:true});
      updateNavigation();
      const email = document.getElementById('contact-email');
      function updateEmail() {
        const value = email.textContent.trim();
        const valid = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value);
        const link = document.getElementById('email-link');
        link.hidden = !valid;
        if(valid) link.href = 'mailto:'+encodeURIComponent(value); else link.removeAttribute('href');
        document.getElementById('contact-hint').hidden = valid;
      }
      email.addEventListener('input',updateEmail); updateEmail();
    })();
  </script>
  <style id="rotation-styles">

    .about.wrap{width:100%;margin:0;padding:0;display:block;border:0}.about .eyebrow{font-family:var(--pixel);font-size:1.1rem;letter-spacing:.04em;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8052a3,#5c3b78);border:1px solid #c28cea55;border-radius:999px;padding:.75rem 1.5rem;margin:0 0 1.5rem;box-shadow:0 8px 35px #0005}.about h2{font-family:var(--pixel);font-size:2.2rem;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 1.5rem;padding-left:1rem;font-weight:500}.about h2 br{display:none}.about-copy{padding:2rem;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#583972f0,#352244f0);border:1px solid #b882d650;border-radius:42px;box-shadow:0 14px 50px #0005,inset 0 1px #efbcff1c}.about-copy .intro{font-size:1.1rem;color:#faeaff;line-height:1.6}.about-copy p{font-size:1rem;color:#d2bddf}.background{margin-top:1.4rem;border-color:#ba8ed23d}.background h3{font-family:var(--pixel);font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:500;color:#f2d9fc}.background span{color:#bfa2d2}.accent{color:#e9b5ff}
    .work{padding-top:3.5rem}.section-heading h2,.contact h2{font-family:var(--pixel);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.03em}.section-heading h2{font-size:3.2rem}.section-heading p{color:#cab4d9}.project-cover{border-radius:36px;border:1px solid #bb87dc4d;box-shadow:0 14px 45px #0005;padding:2rem}.cover-one{background:linear-gradient(125deg,#735294,#322944);color:#f0d4ff}.cover-two{background:linear-gradient(125deg,#4b4277,#27243d);color:#e0d7ff}.cover-three{background:linear-gradient(125deg,#815168,#3d253e);color:#ffd6ed}.cover-caption{font-family:var(--pixel);font-size:3.5rem;font-weight:500}.cover-label,.project-meta,.eyebrow,.hero-rule,.footer,.brand,summary{font-family:var(--pixel)}.cover-label,.project-meta,.hero-rule{font-size:.95rem}.cover-number{font-family:var(--pixel);font-weight:500;color:#eac8ff;opacity:.28}.project h3{font-family:var(--pixel);font-size:1.65rem;font-weight:500}.project details{border-color:#ad81c23b}summary{font-size:1.05rem!important}.project p{color:#c9b5d8}.contact{padding-top:4rem}.contact h2{color:#f1d4ff}.contact-card{background:linear-gradient(125deg,#654184ed,#38234bed);border:1px solid #bd8adc55;border-radius:40px;box-shadow:0 18px 50px #0004;padding:2rem}.contact-card #contact-email{font-family:var(--pixel)}.contact-intro{color:#d3bdde}.footer.wrap{grid-column:1/-1;max-width:1200px;width:100%;margin:1rem 0 0;border-color:#a071bc33;padding-block:2rem}.footer .brand{font-size:1.2rem}.footer .mark{display:none}.footer p{font-size:.95rem;color:#aa8fbf}#main:not([data-current-view="about"]) .footer{width:min(1200px,calc(100% - 6rem));margin-inline:auto}.footer a:last-child{color:#d2b6e5}
    .editor-bar{background:#17101feF;border-color:#9c68bd6e;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);padding-block:.7rem}.editor-bar button{font-family:var(--pixel);font-size:1rem;border-radius:999px;background:#dcafea;color:#2d1939;border-color:#edc6f5;padding:.55rem .9rem}.editor-bar button+button{border-color:#a779bd66;color:#edd8f4}.editor-bar p{color:#c8afdb}body.editing [contenteditable]{outline-color:#f0c4ff99}body.editing [contenteditable]:focus{outline-color:#f0c4ff}.skip-link{background:#e8bdf4;color:#271337}.rotation-layer .header{z-index:auto}
    @media(max-width:1000px){.header.wrap{min-height:235px;padding:3rem 2rem;gap:2rem}.header nav{gap:1.2rem}.header .brand{font-size:4.3rem}.header nav a{font-size:1.1rem}#main[data-current-view="about"]{gap:2rem;width:calc(100% - 4rem)}.hero.wrap{padding:2.2rem}.hero h1{font-size:3rem}.about h2{font-size:1.9rem}}
    @media(max-width:760px){.wrap{width:calc(100% - 2.5rem)}.header.wrap{padding:2.4rem 1.5rem 2.5rem;min-height:220px;border-radius:0 0 44px 44px;display:block}.header .brand{font-size:clamp(3rem,12vw,4.8rem);justify-content:center}.header nav{margin-top:1.8rem;padding:0;gap:1rem;justify-content:center}.header nav a{font-size:1.1rem;padding:.3rem .2rem .5rem}#main[data-current-view="about"]{display:block;width:calc(100% - 2.5rem);padding-top:2.3rem}.hero.wrap{padding:2rem;border-radius:36px}.hero h1{font-size:2.8rem}.about.wrap{margin-top:2.2rem}.about-copy{border-radius:32px;padding:1.6rem}.about h2{font-size:2rem}.hero-rule{font-size:.8rem}.section-heading h2{font-size:2.7rem}.project-cover{border-radius:30px;min-height:265px}.cover-caption{font-size:3rem}.contact{padding-top:2.8rem}.contact h2{font-size:3rem}.contact-card{border-radius:30px;padding:1.6rem}#main:not([data-current-view="about"]) .footer{width:calc(100% - 2.5rem)}.editor-bar p{font-size:.8rem}.footer.wrap{padding-top:1.7rem}}
    .about h2 br{display:initial}
  </style>
  <style id="space-motion-styles">
    .transitioning{overflow:hidden}.transitioning #portfolio-screen{will-change:opacity;pointer-events:none}#portfolio-screen,.rotation-layer{transform-origin:initial}
    :root{--pixel:'Space Grotesk',Arial,sans-serif}body{font-family:'Inter',Arial,sans-serif}.header .brand{font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.06em;text-shadow:none}.header nav a{font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.025em}.hero h1{font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.055em;line-height:1.12}.hero .eyebrow,.about .eyebrow,.cover-label{font-family:'Inter',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.12em;font-weight:600}.hero .eyebrow{line-height:1.6}.button{font-weight:600;font-size:1rem}.about h2,.section-heading h2,.contact h2{font-weight:600}.cover-caption{letter-spacing:-.055em;font-weight:600}.project-meta,.footer,.hero-rule{font-family:'Inter',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:.85rem}.editor-bar button{font-family:'Inter',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:.85rem}.background h3{font-family:'Inter',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600}
    #space-backdrop{position:fixed;inset:-30px;z-index:0;background:var(--paper) var(--starfield) center/cover;pointer-events:none;animation:space-drift 38s ease-in-out infinite alternate;opacity:.8}#star-motion{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:0;pointer-events:none}#portfolio-screen{z-index:1;background:transparent}.rotation-layer{background:rgba(8,8,18,.68);background-image:none}.warp-active #star-motion{z-index:12}.editor-bar{z-index:20}@keyframes space-drift{from{transform:translate3d(-10px,-8px,0) scale(1.04)}to{transform:translate3d(10px,8px,0) scale(1.08)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#space-backdrop{animation:none}#star-motion{display:none}}
  </style>
  <script id="space-motion">
    (() => {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('star-motion');
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      if (!ctx) return;
      const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
      let width = 0, height = 0, stars = [], frame, previous = 0, scrollWarp = 0, lastScroll = scrollY, lastScrollTime = performance.now(), lastMotionTime = -Infinity;
      let scrollDirection = -1;
      const makeStar = () => ({x:Math.random()*width,y:Math.random()*height,size:.6+Math.random()*1.4,phase:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,speed:.35+Math.random()*.65});
      function resize() {
        width = innerWidth; height = innerHeight;
        const ratio = Math.min(devicePixelRatio || 1,1.5);
        canvas.width = Math.round(width*ratio); canvas.height = Math.round(height*ratio);
        ctx.setTransform(ratio,0,0,ratio,0,0);
        stars = Array.from({length:width < 760 ? 95 : 170},makeStar);
      }
      function draw(now) {
        frame = undefined;
        if (document.hidden || reducedMotion.matches) { previous = 0; return; }
        const dt = Math.min(now-(previous || now),40); previous = now;
        if(now-lastMotionTime > 70) scrollWarp *= Math.exp(-dt/180);
        const intensity = scrollWarp;
        const warping = intensity > .025;
        ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);
        for (const star of stars) {
          star.y += scrollDirection*intensity*dt*1.5*star.speed + dt*.007*star.speed;
          if (star.y < -220 || star.y > height+220) {
            star.x = Math.random()*width;
            star.y = scrollDirection < 0 ? height+Math.random()*100 : -Math.random()*100;
          }
          const twinkle = .45+.25*Math.sin(now*.0006+star.phase);
          if (intensity > .02) {
            const length = 210*intensity*star.speed;
            const tailX = star.x;
            const tailY = star.y-scrollDirection*length;
            const trail = ctx.createLinearGradient(tailX,tailY,star.x,star.y);
            trail.addColorStop(0,'rgba(178,115,239,0)');
            trail.addColorStop(.7,`rgba(202,151,255,${intensity*.55})`);
            trail.addColorStop(1,`rgba(255,241,255,${Math.min(.9,twinkle+intensity*.35)})`);
            ctx.strokeStyle = trail; ctx.lineWidth = star.size*.9;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tailX,tailY); ctx.lineTo(star.x,star.y); ctx.stroke();
          }
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(245,221,255,${twinkle})`;
          ctx.fillRect(star.x,star.y,star.size,star.size);
        }
        if (!warping) document.body.classList.remove('warp-active');
        frame = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
      }
      function resume() {
        if(frame) cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
        previous = 0;
        if(!document.hidden && !reducedMotion.matches) frame = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
        else { ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height); document.body.classList.remove('warp-active'); scrollWarp = 0; }
      }
      window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
        const now = performance.now();
        const delta = scrollY-lastScroll;
        const distance = Math.abs(delta);
        const elapsed = Math.max(16,now-lastScrollTime);
        lastScroll = scrollY; lastScrollTime = now;
        if(reducedMotion.matches || distance < 1) return;
        scrollDirection = delta > 0 ? -1 : 1;
        scrollWarp = Math.min(.9,Math.max(scrollWarp,distance/elapsed*.3));
        lastMotionTime = now;
      }, {passive:true});
      window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',resume);
      reducedMotion.addEventListener('change',resume);
      resize(); resume();
    })();
  </script>
<style id="single-page-styles">
    html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:2rem}.intro-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.12fr 1fr;gap:3.5rem;max-width:1200px;width:calc(100% - 6rem);margin:0 auto;padding-top:4.5rem;align-items:start}.intro-layout .hero.wrap,.intro-layout .about.wrap{width:100%;margin:0}#projects{padding-block:5rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}#contact{padding-bottom:4rem}.header nav a[aria-current="location"]{color:#fff4ff;border-color:#f2cef9}.header nav a[aria-current="location"]:after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-7px;left:calc(50% - 4px);width:8px;height:8px;background:#fff0ff;transform:rotate(45deg)}@media(max-width:1000px){.intro-layout{gap:2rem;width:calc(100% - 4rem)}}@media(max-width:760px){.intro-layout{display:block;width:calc(100% - 2.5rem);padding-top:2.3rem}.intro-layout .about.wrap{margin-top:2.2rem}#projects{padding-block:3rem}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}}
  </style>
<style id="compact-header-styles">
  :root{--header-height:148px;--header-compact-height:70px}html{scroll-padding-top:calc(var(--header-compact-height) + 24px)}#header-space{height:var(--header-height);pointer-events:none}.header.wrap{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:15;width:100%;height:var(--header-height);min-height:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:nowrap;gap:2rem;padding:1.6rem max(2rem,calc((100vw - 1200px)/2));border-radius:0 0 42px 42px;transition:height .22s ease,padding .22s ease,border-radius .22s ease,box-shadow .22s ease;backdrop-filter:blur(18px)}.header .brand{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,4vw,3.5rem);line-height:1.1;transition:font-size .22s ease}.header nav{width:auto;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;gap:1.8rem}.header nav a{font-size:1rem;padding:.6rem 0}.header.is-compact{height:var(--header-compact-height);padding:.7rem max(2rem,calc((100vw - 1200px)/2));border-radius:0 0 22px 22px;background:linear-gradient(115deg,#654082f5,#412954f5);box-shadow:0 8px 25px #0005}.header.is-compact .brand{font-size:1.6rem}.header.is-compact nav a{font-size:.9rem}.intro-layout{padding-top:3rem}.skip-link{z-index:30}@media(max-width:760px){:root{--header-height:142px;--header-compact-height:96px}.header.wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:1rem;padding:1.2rem 1.3rem;border-radius:0 0 30px 30px}.header .brand{font-size:2.3rem}.header nav{width:100%;justify-content:center;gap:1.7rem;margin:0;padding:0}.header nav a{font-size:.9rem;padding:.45rem .15rem}.header.is-compact{padding:.65rem 1rem;gap:.3rem;border-radius:0 0 18px 18px}.header.is-compact .brand{font-size:1.35rem}.header.is-compact nav a{font-size:.85rem}.intro-layout{padding-top:2rem}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.header.wrap,.header .brand{transition:none}}
</style>
<script id="compact-header-script">
  (()=>{
    const header=document.querySelector('.header');
    if(!header)return;
    let spacer=document.getElementById('header-space');
    if(!spacer){spacer=document.createElement('div');spacer.id='header-space';spacer.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');header.before(spacer);}
    let scheduled=false;
    function update(){scheduled=false;header.classList.toggle('is-compact',scrollY>64);}
    window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{if(!scheduled){scheduled=true;requestAnimationFrame(update);}},{passive:true});
    window.addEventListener('pageshow',update);update();
  })();
</script>
